items.title: 3.2 Centripetal force (centre ki taraf kheenchne wali force) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.2 with Figs. 3.6 to 3.10 and Examples 3.2 and 3.3 (PDF 59-62).

blocks.text: Newton ka doosra law kehta hai ke object par force lage to usi direction mein acceleration paida hota hai. Agar force chalte object ki velocity ki direction mein lage to sirf speed badalti hai, direction wahi rehti hai. Lekin agar daire mein chalte object par force hamesha velocity ke perpendicular (90° par) lage to direction badalti hai magar speed wahi rehti hai. Aisi force object mein radial (centripetal, centre ki taraf) acceleration paida kar ke use daire mein chalati hai; ise centripetal force (centre ki taraf khenchne wali force) kehte hain. Fig. 3.6(a) mein dori se bandhi gend horizontal daire mein ghumai ja rahi hai. Agar dori toot jaye to gend daire mein nahi chalti. Agar gend point A par ho jab dori toote (Fig. 3.6b) to gend seedhi line AB par chali jati hai, jo A par daire ki tangent hai.

blocks.alt: Ek shakhs horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) rangeen disc ke neeche khara hai jo daire ka plane (chapta hissa) dikhati hai. Us ka utha hua haath centre (beech ka point) par dori pakarta hai; dori daire ke kinare par gend tak jati hai. Dori par teer F gend se haath ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6(a): Dori se bandhi gend horizontal daire mein ghumai ja rahi hai (kitab ki Figure 3.6(a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: Centre O wala daira, us par teer anticlockwise motion (chalna ya hilna) dikhata hai. Daire par point A se O tak line, us par teer F O ki taraf. A se tangent ke saath dashed teer B par khatam hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6(b): Agar dori A par toot jaye to gend tangent AB par chalti hai (kitab ki Figure 3.6(b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Dori tootte hi centre ki taraf khenchne wali force khatam ho jati hai, is liye gend us lamhe ki velocity ki direction mein, yani point A par tangent AB ke saath, seedhi chali jati hai (Newton ka pehla law).
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Is liye uniform (ek jaisi) speed se daire mein chalte object ki direction har point par badalne ke liye force chahiye. Yeh force speed nahi badalti, sirf direction badalti hai; yeh radius ke saath perpendicular force hai jo hamesha object ko daire ke centre ki taraf khenchti hai. Har point par is ki direction tangential velocity ke perpendicular hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Daire par kai point, har ek par tangent ke saath velocity ka teer v; sab teer barabar lambe hain magar object clockwise ghoomte hue un ki direction (rukh) badalti jati hai. Ek point par agla velocity teer usi dum (tail) par la kar banaya gaya hai, dashed line yeh shift dikhati hai, aur dono siron ko jorne wala chhota teer, jo daire ke andar ki taraf hai, delta v hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 59): circular motion (daire mein chalna) mein motion ki direction lagatar badalti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Daire ke har point par velocity ka teer tangent ke saath hai, aur har point par is ki direction alag hai. Velocity ki magnitude (yani speed) wahi hai magar direction lagatar badal rahi hai; isi badlao ke liye centripetal force chahiye.

blocks.text: Particle ke seedhe raste ko mod kar daire mein badalne ke liye jo force chahiye use centripetal force kehte hain.
blocks.title: Centripetal force

blocks.text: Mass m ka object radius r ke daire mein velocity v se chal raha ho to centripetal force F꜀:
Yahan a = v²/r centripetal acceleration hai jis ki direction daire ke centre ki taraf hai. Chunke v = rω, is liye:

blocks.title: Example 3.2
blocks.problem: CD 210 rpm (revolutions per minute) se ghoom rahi hai. CD ke outer kinare (rim) par kisi point ka radial acceleration kya hai? CD ka diameter 12 cm hai.
steps: Pehle 210 rpm ko revolutions per second (Hz) mein badlein: f = 210 rev/min × (1 min / 60 s) = 3.5 rev/s = 3.5 Hz
Har chakkar mein CD 2π radian ghoomti hai: ω = 2πf = 2π rad/rev × 3.5 rev/s = 7.0π rad s⁻¹
a = ω²r = (7.0π rad s⁻¹)² × 0.06 m ≈ 29 m s⁻²
blocks.answer: Rim par radial acceleration ≈ 29 m s⁻² (g ka taqreeban teen guna).

blocks.text: Kitab ω wali line mein units ulte likhti hai: “2π rev/min × 3.5 min/s”. Sahi: har chakkar 2π rad hai aur f = 3.5 rev/s, is liye ω = 2π rad/rev × 3.5 rev/s = 7.0π rad s⁻¹. Jawab wahi rehta hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Tez speed par mur kar urna (curved flight) bohat bari centripetal force maangta hai, is liye yeh stunt khatarnak hai, chahe jahaz aapas mein zyada qareeb na bhi hon.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
Example 3.3
blocks.problem: Dori ke sire par bandhi gend gravity ke asar mein radius r ke vertical daire mein ghumai jati hai (Fig. 3.7). Jab gend raste ke sab se oonche point A par ho aur us ki speed v ho, to dori mein tension kitni hogi?
steps: Gend daire mein chale, is ke liye us par lagne wali kul force centripetal force ke barabar honi chahiye.
Point A par do forces neeche (centre ki taraf) lagti hain: dori ki tension T aur gend ka wazan w. Dono radius ke saath hain, is liye in ka jor centripetal force deta hai:
T + w = mv²/r, aur w = mg
blocks.answer: Agar v²/r = g ho to T = 0: sirf wazan hi centripetal force ka kaam kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Vertical (seedha khara) daira, centre O aur sab se ooncha point A. A par orange teer v tangent ke saath baen taraf hai, aur AO ke saath do neeche ke teer hain: chhota neela w aur lamba hara T. Daire par teer dikhata hai ke gend anticlockwise ghoomti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.7: Vertical daire mein ghoomti gend: oopar point A par tension T aur wazan w dono AO ke saath (kitab ki Figure 3.7 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Sab se oonche point A par tension T aur wazan w dono neeche centre O ki taraf hain, aur velocity v tangent ke saath (bayen taraf) hai. Isi liye A par T + w = mv²/r likha gaya.
